capabilities: play folder-based music from a persistent sidebar player
trigger one-shot sound effects and looping ambience from searchable pickers
crossfade and fade music, loops, and SFX with configurable durations
embed audio buttons in notes via Markdown codeblocks and context menus
combine a music track and loops into scene buttons
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play music, sound effects, and looping ambience during play sessions or from embedded note buttons.
summary: Sidebar audio player that manages music tracks, one-shot sound effects, and looping ambience with fades, per-category volumes, and note-embedded audio buttons.
